}}'''Samel Crawe''' is from [[Emond's Field]]. He is a member of the [[Village Council]]. [[Bandry Crawe]] is his son.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Samel Crawe}}

== Appearance ==
He is a horse-faced man with a long nose.

== Activities ==
He is part of the Village council, which is in session when [[Padan Fain]] arrives.

He participates in the [[Battle of Emond's Field]].{{ref/book|4|56}}
